Elena — thanks for the clear list. High level plan from our side:

- Legal review & redline reconciliation: Marissa + Rishi will review your PDF and propose alternative language where necessary. Expect a consolidated response by EOD Monday (11/30).
- International transfers: Redwood typically executes the EU SCCs plus offers a standard UK IDTA addendum where required. For FinPrepare (EU/UK footprint) we recommend: EU SCCs + a short UK Addendum (IDTA) referencing the same TIA. Marissa will confirm exact wording.
- Security Annex: we generally accept SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 attestations, encryption in transit + at rest, defined retention/erasure windows, and our standard incident SLA (we'll list SLAs in the annex). If any specific security control is out of scope we'll flag it.
- Subprocessors: Redwood provides a current subprocessor list and commits to 30-day notice for material changes; we will not use subprocessors to process PHI by default.
- Execution: DocuSign is preferred for speed; AdobeSign is also acceptable. Once legal signs off we'll send a DocuSign envelope to procurement@finprepare.com and to your legal mailbox. Please confirm procurement contact for the envelope signer and whether a company stamp is required on your side.

I've attached our current DPA with internal redlines to speed review.

Thanks,

Vivek / Elena,

I reviewed FinPrepare's redlines and Vivek's draft. Summary of our position and suggested text:

- Transfers: We will accept the EU SCCs (2021 clause set) plus execute the standard UK IDTA addendum. To address FinPrepare's request for explicit TIA language, add this sentence to the transfer section: "Supplier will maintain a documented Transfer Impact Assessment evaluating adequacy of measures and, upon reasonable request, provide a redacted summary to the Controller for review." That keeps our operational flexibility while giving them the assurance they asked for.

- Security Annex: Accept the core items: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, SOC2 Type II/ISO27001 attestations (delivered annually), logging/retention windows (default 90 days for request logs, 30 days for ephemeral caches unless otherwise agreed). We cannot accept bespoke security testing obligations or extended forensic support beyond scoped incident response (we can provide forensic materials under an executed SOW).

- Subprocessors: We'll commit to a 30-day notice for new subprocessors and a right to object procedure. Our current subprocessor list will be provided as a link rather than embedded in the contract to avoid frequent amendment noise.

- E-sign: DocuSign preferred. We'll prepare a clean DPA and a minimal Security Annex (attached) and route it for signature. Suggested envelope recipients: procurement@finprepare.com (signature) and elena.rossi@finprepare.com (legal notification). Please confirm whether FinPrepare requires a countersignature page with company stamp or PO number to be returned.

Attached: Redwood_Response_DPA_redlines.docx (tracked changes) and a TIA-summary.txt (high level).

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
